title: Identity coefficient law across a diagram of commuting restriction squares
statement: Let $I,J$ be preorders, $D:I^{op}\to Sch$ and $E:J^{op}\to Sch$ diagrams [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $\sigma:J\to I$ a function. Let $a_j:E_j\to D_{\sigma(j)}$ be scheme morphisms. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and $\varphi_f:f^*F_i\to F_k$ coefficient maps for each $f:i\to k$, satisfying the canonical identity equation using $D.map\_id$ and the inverse-image unit [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. For every $j$ and equality $a_jD(\mathrm{id}_{\sigma(j)})=E(\mathrm{id}_j)a_j$, the explicit coefficient map openSquareCoefficient [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-cohomology-cocone] applied to $\varphi_{\mathrm{id}_{\sigma(j)}}$ equals the inverse-image unit on $a_j^*F_{\sigma(j)}$, preceded by the canonical transport induced by $E.map\_id$. No composition law for the coefficients or naturality of $\sigma$ is required. The restricted sheaves may be given as a family $F\prime_j$ with specified equalities $F\prime_j=a_j^*F_{\sigma(j)}$; the coefficient maps $\psi_j$ are given with heterogeneous equalities to the explicit square coefficients. The assertion is the canonical identity equation for these specified $F\prime_j$ and $\psi_j$.

proof.text: Identify the specified restricted sheaf with the actual inverse-image sheaf using hF-prime, and the specified coefficient with openSquareCoefficient using h-psi. Fix j and substitute the coefficient identity. Transport along D.map_id and E.map_id so both horizontal scheme arrows are identities. Expand openSquareCoefficient. Apply upperStarComp_id_left and upperStarComp_id_right; the pulled-back original unit cancels its inverse, leaving the restricted unit. Restore the E.map_id transport.

theorem openSquareCoefficient_diagram_identity
    {I J : Type u} [Preorder I] [Preorder J]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (E : Jᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (σ : J → I)
    (a : ∀ j, E.obj (op j) ⟶ D.obj (op (σ j)))
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (h : ∀ j, a j ≫ D.map (homOfLE (le_refl (σ j))).op =
      E.map (homOfLE (le_refl j)).op ≫ a j)
    (F' : ∀ j, Sheaf (E.obj (op j)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF' : ∀ j, F' j = (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (a j)).obj (F (σ j)))
    (ψ : ∀ j, (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (E.map (homOfLE (le_refl j)).op)).obj (F' j) ⟶ F' j)
    (hψ : ∀ j, HEq (ψ j)
      (openSquareCoefficient (D.map (homOfLE (le_refl (σ j))).op) (a j) (a j)
        (E.map (homOfLE (le_refl j)).op) (h j) (F (σ j)) (F (σ j))
        (φ (homOfLE (le_refl (σ j))))))
    (j : J) :
    ψ j =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (E.map_id (op j)))).hom.app
        (F' j) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (E.obj (op j))).hom.app (F' j)
